title.value: Dev2vec: Representing Domain Expertise of Developers in an Embedding Space
title.justification: The title of the paper directly states the main focus of the research, which is to represent domain expertise of developers using a method called Dev2vec.
title.quote: Dev2vec: Representing Domain Expertise of Developers in an Embedding Space

extractions.description: This paper presents a novel approach called Dev2vec to represent the domain expertise of software developers as embedding vectors. These vectors are derived from various sources on GitHub, such as repository descriptions, issue resolving history, and API usage. The study evaluates the effectiveness of these embeddings in classifying developers into technical job roles and aims to outperform existing expertise assessment methods by enhancing the representation of developer skills across multiple software projects.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central focus of the paper is on improving the assessment of domain expertise among software developers. It does not primarily address climate, ecological, or sustainable development topics.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we employ doc2vec to represent the domain expertise of developers as embedding vectors.

primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily focused on the technical aspect of developer expertise assessment and does not directly address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: Propose a method to represent the expertise of developers in embedding vectors by applying doc2vec on different sources of information.

primary_sub_category.justification: Similarly, the content does not align with specific sub-categories under Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_sub_category.quote: These sources of information can inform the representation of developers’ expertise.
